title: CraigsCast
tagline: Collaborative tools for Landlords to enable listing and maintenance of rental properties on Farcaster, receive active rental NFT badges, maintain CRM of prospective buyers and share receipts to tenants.
description:
Collaborative tools for Landlords to enable listing and maintenance of rental properties on Farcaster, receive active rental NFT badges, maintain CRM of prospective clients and share receipts to tenants.

Track, trace and record listing and maintenance of rental properties on Farcaster, receive active rental NFT badges, maintain CRM of prospective buyers using Neynar and share receipts to tenants using XMTP, verification and account abstraction using zero knowledge proofs built using circom and noir deployed on Polygon zkEVM, Optimism and Base, Web3 ecosystem tools on XMTP, AirStack and Frame.js.

We are also developing tools to enable tracing, monitoring and recording of rental properties and rent receipts, invoices in a scalable manner using Dynamic SDK, Base and Optimism; AIOps using Open Rank APIs from Karma3Labs. 

We are developing Base AA tools to plan maintenance activities, receive anonymous feedback reports by tenants, neighbors, store feedback details and strategize more productively and do early stage prevention of housing maintenance issues. We are enabling onchain composability using Airstack and extending the reports as frames quickly using Frames.js.

We are also developing AA tools to support operations like sending DAI and USDC payment amounts, zk signing of the transaction and other cryptographic operations across multiple platforms and blockchains that improve the overall usability and interoperability.
how_its_made:
We are developing tools to track, trace and record listing and maintenance of rental properties on Farcaster, receive active rental NFT badges, maintain CRM of prospective buyers using Neynar, verification and account abstraction using zero knowledge proofs built using circom and noir deployed on Polygon zkEVM, Optimism and Base, Web3 ecosystem tools on XMTP, AirStack and Frame.js.

 We are implementing XMTP Chat for property owners and administrators in a particular region with CyberConnect functions.  We are enabling interoperability of the Farcaster frames developed with OpenFrames and communicating the property maintenance and billing/invoicing related messages on XMTP. Receipts can also be shared with tenants via XMTP.
